title: Rosemary Beach: Anam Cara + Carriage House in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Anam Cara + Carriage House in Rosemary Beach. Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Anam Cara + Carriage House - A Stunning 4-Bedroom Beach Retreat including the guest house

Anam Cara is a beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home, with a 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom guest house, ideally located within walking distance to several private beach access points, a community fitness center, and four neighborhood pools.

Perfect for outdoor living, this home features a private pool, a covered patio, and a custom-designed firepit area*-all designed for relaxation and entertaining. The spacious 2-story layout invites guests to unwind in comfort and style. The main living area boasts an oversized sectional centered around a fireplace and TV, perfect for cozy evenings after a day in the sun. Just behind, a quiet nook with two armchairs offers a peaceful spot to relax with a book or drink.

Adjacent to the living area, the dining space features a mix of chair and bench seating for up to eight guests, with a nearby wet bar for convenient entertaining. The gourmet kitchen is a dream, showcasing elegant marble countertops, a farmhouse sink, and plenty of natural light.

Step through the great room to enjoy seamless access to the outdoor patio, where guests can lounge on plush furniture around the firepit, dine alfresco at a 4-person table, or cool off in the private pool.

Upstairs, you'll find three inviting bedrooms. The primary suite and a guest room each feature king-sized beds and share a balcony-ideal for enjoying morning coffee or evening breezes. A charming bunk room offers a queen-over-king bed and access to a private deck with sweeping views.

Additional amenities include on-site parking and four adult bikes for easy neighborhood exploring. For larger groups, Anam Cara can be rented along with the adjacent Anam Cara Carriage House.

Recently built and beautifully designed, the carriage house offers the perfect blend of comfort and coastal charm. With thoughtful finishes and light, airy décor, it's an ideal retreat for couples or small families.

Inside, you'll find a cozy queen bedroom, a full bathroom, and a welcoming living area with a sleeper sofa for additional guests. The fully equipped kitchen and dining space make it easy to enjoy meals at home, while the stylish coastal accents create a serene and relaxing atmosphere.

Conveniently located just a short walk from North Barrett Square and less than a 2-minute walk to the Cabana Pool and Sky Pool, this home places you in the heart of Rosemary Beach while still offering a private, peaceful retreat.

Need less space? Check out the Anam Cara listing, or the Anam Cara Carriage House listing today!

*Please note: the outdoor firepit is not available for guest use.

This home requires a 7-night stay, Saturday to Saturday, during Spring Break and Summer.
